name: toast-js-build-poc-vite
description: Proof of concept: building the Toast-JS build-poc fixture with Vite library mode.

scripts.build: npm run build:unmin && npm run build:min
scripts.build:unmin: POC_CLEAN=1 POC_TARGET=esm vite build && POC_TARGET=consumer vite build && POC_TARGET=browser vite build
scripts.build:min: POC_CLEAN=1 POC_TARGET=esm POC_MIN=1 vite build && POC_TARGET=consumer POC_MIN=1 vite build && POC_TARGET=browser POC_MIN=1 vite build
